title: Composition of Sign Noise Operators
statement: For all real numbers $\rho,\sigma$ and every function $f:\{-1,1\}\to\mathbb R$, applying the sign noise operator with parameter $\sigma$ and then with parameter $\rho$ gives the sign noise operator with parameter $\rho\sigma$: $T_\rho(T_\sigma f)=T_{\rho\sigma}f$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the sign set
